transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you too. Thanks for taking the time to see me. 

Um, I guess I'm here because... well, I've been having a little trouble at work lately. I mean, I'm a construction manager, so it's a busy job, lots of moving parts, and I usually handle it okay! But... lately, I've noticed I'm struggling a bit with the safety briefings and plan reviews. 

I'll sit down, really trying hard to pay attention—I want to do a good job, you know? But then, within just a few minutes, my mind just... wanders off. I start thinking about three other problems on the site, and before I know it, I've missed things. Things I know I should have caught. 

I hope that makes sense? I'm just worried it's starting to affect my work, and I really want to be on top of things. Is that the kind of thing you can help with?
Have you had trouble paying attention like this since you were a child?

Yeah, um... I guess it's been going on for a while. I mean, I was just a really active kid, you know? Normal boy stuff, mostly! But... well, I suppose back in elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents that I, um... that I couldn't really stay in my seat. 

And I guess I talked out of turn sometimes. I just got so excited to participate, you know? I never meant to be disrespectful or anything. I also... well, I lost my homework a fair bit, and I had this habit of rushing through directions before I really understood them. I just wanted to get the work done quickly to show I could do it, but I'd end up messing it up. 

I really did try to be a good student, though, I promise. I hope
Do you have this same trouble paying attention outside of work too?
Well, um... yeah, I guess it does bleed over into home life a bit. I mean, my wife is wonderful, she's so patient with me, but... I think she
At home, do these attention problems cause trouble for you?

...well, I think she gets a little worn down sometimes. I mean, I always mean to do the things I say I'll handle around the house, I really do. But I'll get distracted, or I'll just... forget. And she ends up having to remind me a lot. I feel terrible about it, because I want to be a good partner, you know? I really try to pull my weight. 

And, um... I guess I should probably mention, since you're asking about trouble... it's gotten a bit worse at work than I made it sound earlier. I didn't want to make a big deal out of it, but... I've been missing some follow-ups, and my site coordination hasn't been as organized as it should be. It actually led to, um, my employer expressing some formal concern recently. 

I'm really embarrassed about it, to be honest. I want to be reliable, both for my wife and my boss. Does that... does that help explain things a bit better? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have these focus problems gotten noticeably worse only recently?

Well, um... I guess it depends a little on what you'd call recent. I really thought I could just push through it on my own, so I didn't want to complain or make a fuss too early, but... it's actually been going on for a bit. I'd say it's been seriously disrupting my job for about two years and two months now. 

That was right around the time our construction schedule changed, and the hours just got a lot more chaotic. I really did try my best to adapt to the new shifts—I always try to be flexible for the crew and do what's asked of me—but it just became too much to juggle in my head. I probably should have
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Oh, um... no, not really. I mean, I get a little frustrated with myself sometimes, just because... well, because I really want to be doing a good job, you know? But I wouldn't say I'm depressed or feeling down. 

I try to keep a pretty positive attitude, mostly. I don't want to be a burden or bring my wife or the guys on the crew down with me. So, yeah, my mood is generally fine. Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm answering that right for you.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?

Um... no, not really anxious, I don't think. I mean, sure, I worry a little bit about letting people down, especially with the stuff at work and making sure my wife isn't too stressed out. But I wouldn't call it, like, real anxiety or anything. 

I don't sit around panicking or feeling all wound up, you know? I just... I just want to make sure everyone's happy and that I'm doing what I'm supposed to do. I hope that's okay to say. I'm not trying to make it sound like I don't care, I just... I don't feel like I'm an anxious person, generally. Does that sound like what you were asking about?
Have you been having trouble with your memory?

Um, no, I don't think so. My memory is actually pretty good, I'd say. I mean, sure, I might misplace a tape measure or leave my coffee on the truck bumper every now and then, but... that's just normal, right? 

I don't have any real trouble remembering things. Like, I know all the job specs and the guys' names and what happened last week perfectly fine. It's more just... keeping it all straight when everything is happening at once on the site. But my actual memory itself is fine. I definitely wouldn't want you to think my brain is failing or anything bad like that! Does that answer your question okay? I can try to explain it better if you need me to.
